rules: All161 instruction and89 hardware IDs are retained. Overlap/work-package counts are not independent features or a completion percentage.

A row resolves phase states, exact support scope, code/tests/evidence and its next test through its profile; its work package assigns the finite release task. Catalogue arguments, operands, constraints and original primary sources remain authoritative through domain+ID and pinned catalogue/record hashes.
No profile claims full family completion. Each newly admitted mode/operand/context needs its own scope and evidence; documentary manual_only/documented status cannot promote implementation.
Source-equivalent C++ lowering, exact native-opcode import, standalone codec foundation and integrated whole-project support are distinct states.
Editor and simulator observations are tied to exact historical artifacts. Handbuilt diagnostics do not establish generated-product support or successful native communication.
Missing compiler support remains toolchain work under PARITY.md. Model absence/unknown eligibility requires target-specific primary evidence and does not erase other inventory rows.
Existing catalogue API defaults remain documentary missing/pending. This matrix is the separately scoped implementation/evidence overlay; it does not change the CLI catalogue API.

phases.cpp_sdk: Restricted source/API representation; source_equivalent_subset explicitly distinguishes lowered algorithm from literal native opcode.
phases.il_vm: Exact native/typed IL validation and execution domains.
phases.smbp_graph: Strict native config/graph import/export; standalone codec is not whole-project admission.
phases.reverse: Reconstruct actual admitted IL/config; exact native opcode versus lowered-form scope stated.
phases.local_oracle: Existing scoped local tests/reports, not a new run in this audit.
phases.simulator: Bounded actual official runtime observations, distinct from editor save; Modbus transaction proof is separate.

states.codec_only: Existing tests validate the isolated serialization component, not native runtime.
states.covered_subset: Implemented/tested only within the profile scope; not the complete source record.
states.handbuilt_diagnostic_only: Official observations exist for a manually authored diagnostic, not generated-product support.
states.inactive_defaults_only: Only inactive/default native configuration is admitted or preserved.
states.lowered_form_only: Reverse supports the admitted lowered form, not the named native construct itself.
states.native_opcode_not_implemented: The exact native spelling/context is not admitted; source-level equivalent may exist.
states.not_applicable: Model-specific primary evidence establishes absence; no broader family exclusion.
states.not_implemented: No integrated implementation in this documented profile.
states.not_transaction_validated: Editor acceptance/local transport exists but successful native transactions remain unobserved.
states.observed_subset: Existing official artifact-scoped observations within the stated profile.
states.pending: This gate has not been observed for the applicable target/profile.
states.refusal_only: Existing local check covers explicit unsupported-active refusal.
states.source_equivalent_subset: C++ algorithm has a bounded lowering; exact native opcode admission is not implied.
states.standalone_foundation_only: Isolated codec exists, not whole-project/SDK/VM integration.
states.target_eligibility_unresolved: Target-specific support/absence has not been established.
states.unassessed_row_specific: The broad row needs a named service/setting audit; related implementations do not prove it.

boolean.scope: Normal embedded I0.0..23/Q0.0..15, M0..1023, allowlisted S bits, MW bit selectors; ordinary Boolean lowering and serial graphs. Native process images only in admitted isolated MAST execution.
boolean.remaining: Close remaining BOOL_READ/WRITE banks, writable-system permissions, graph variants, first-scan/STOP/RUN/edge lifecycle and all operand-specific semantics. Ordinary image access is not immediate physical access.
boolean.next_test: Exercise each remaining BOOL_READ/BOOL_WRITE bank and writable-system permission with valid endpoints, read-after-write/alias and rejected-store controls; bind each new graph shape to an exact native save.

native_edges.scope: LDR/LDF/ANDR/ANDF/ORR/ORF/XORR/XORF on admitted I0/M operands; local execution history, reverse and serial normalization.
native_edges.remaining: Prove startup, held/repeated evaluation and skipped-call lifecycle in native runtime; other operand banks and physical edge semantics remain open.
native_edges.next_test: Compare first-RUN, held/repeated, skipped and fresh-edge I/M traces against native observed outputs; test each newly admitted operand bank separately.

expression_edges.scope: Identified RISINGn/FALLINGn source/IL/local models; SMBP uses persistent M/gates rather than admitting arbitrary raw block graph enums.
expression_edges.remaining: Raw expression-edge XML/functional-level profile and lifecycle equivalence require proof; local identity/history policies do not establish physical behavior.
expression_edges.next_test: Capture one exact native RISING/FALLING graph/functional-level binding, then compare skipped/repeated-site histories and current M/gate expansion to independent traces.

stack.scope: Native MPS/MRD/MPP and supported parenthesized Boolean expressions decode/execute/reverse; normalized serial graph export.
stack.remaining: Resolve documented native stack depth 11/32 conflict and remaining parentheses/operator restrictions; no new explicit C++ stack API is claimed.
stack.next_test: Resolve the documented stack-depth boundary with an exact native boundary/overflow control; test remaining parenthesized operators without changing evaluation order.

numeric.scope: Explicit i16/i32/f32 APIs; MW/MD/MF shared cells, admitted comparisons/operations, numeric graph serialization; operations are individually selected below, not inferred from one numeric fixture.
numeric.remaining: Remaining banks/constants/table operands, complex native expressions, numeric error recovery/SW17, operation-specific flags/indeterminate results and physical rounding/overflow remain open. Export existence is not proof every operation was opened/run.
numeric.next_test: For each unsupported operand/flag/error domain, add a literal signed/float boundary oracle and actual post-error flag/recovery trace, then forward/reverse the exact operation and graph.

conversion.scope: BTI/ITB 16/32, LW/HW, CONCATW low-word first, DWORD and four REAL/integer conversions in the exact local operand/error domains.
conversion.remaining: Invalid/indeterminate native result recovery, other banks, signed DWORD interpretation and physical conversion/rounding need completion. BCD vectors are not scans or native PLC proof.
conversion.next_test: Add signed DWORD/CONCATW alias and invalid-BCD/error-recovery native controls; assert exact output words/flags and reverse identity for each newly admitted bank.

incdec.scope: INC/DEC canonical MW/MD native IL parse/reverse; explicit source add/sub expresses increment/decrement without promising preservation of native INC/DEC spelling.
incdec.remaining: Other banks/operands and native flag/error equivalence; retain source-equivalent versus exact opcode distinction.
incdec.next_test: Compare native INC/DEC versus explicit typed add/sub at signed boundaries and aliases, including exact flags and error recovery.

unimplemented_numeric.scope: Documented operation remains outside the closed numeric API/opcode set inspected in numeric.OPS.
unimplemented_numeric.remaining: Implement each named operation, typed operand/flag/error domain, reverse and graph path with independent boundary oracle. Do not silently substitute host math.
unimplemented_numeric.next_test: Add a RED typed/API/native-IL/reverse case for the exact operation in this row, with finite valid/invalid-domain literal values and an exact native graph candidate.

table_string.scope: Native ASCII/string/table instruction family is documented; generic C++ arrays and bounded loops do not imply these exact native operations are decoded or reverse-supported.
table_string.remaining: Define typed buffers/lengths/overlap/encoding/error semantics, API/state and complete native/reverse path. Determine which algorithms can use an explicitly proven lowering instead of native opcode preservation.
table_string.next_test: Select the exact row opcode and define buffer length/encoding/overlap/error rules; add independent zero/max-length/alias/error vectors and native forward/reverse admission tests.

control.scope: Master while/for/do, break/continue, labels/goto and native JMP/JMPC/JMPCN, per-context source maps; closed graph bindings and semantic lowering.
control.remaining: Complete remaining flow/operator/graph profiles, prove budget/watchdog distinction and broader contexts; native control source constructs are classified separately.
control.next_test: Add one previously refused native flow/graph pattern with entry, exit, loop/alias and label-preservation traces; distinguish tool execution budgets from native watchdog behavior.

source_structures.scope: C++ if/else and bounded/unbounded loops lower to ordinary branch IL; this is source-level algorithm support, not native textual IF/ELSE/ENDIF/FOR/ENDFOR decoding.
source_structures.remaining: Audit exact native construct semantics and reverse import; prove equivalent lowered form or add strict native opcode support where necessary.
source_structures.next_test: Compare each native IF/ELSE/ENDIF/FOR/ENDFOR construct to its explicit C++/JMP lowering, including zero iterations, nesting and stateful evaluation order; either prove equivalence or implement strict import.

end.scope: Master END/ENDC/ENDCN local execution and strict native END/EndCn graph import; Master export uses semantic Jump normalization. Callee current-level END/ENDC is a separately bounded subroutine profile.
end.remaining: Do not infer callee ENDCN admission from Master EndCn fixtures. Native unconditional END must stand alone. Broader runtime/graph combinations and physical behavior remain open.
end.next_test: Keep Master END/ENDC/ENDCN and leaf return cases separate; bind raw leaf ENDCN and reject prefix-LD unconditional END, with caller-continuation and skipped-leaf suffix controls.

subroutine.scope: C++ Subroutine descriptor 2/4 literal args; IDs0..63, independent number/name/section; JSONv2/context origins, shared scan I/O/clock, current-level returns, reverse. Native export only actual Man21, Master section0 plus one stateless leaf section2, supported direct series leaves; normal M0..1023/observed I0.0 call predicates.
subroutine.remaining: Nested/stateful leaves, leaf loops/labels/indexed access, multiple native leaves/layouts and raw leaf ENDCN/constant/compound graphs remain gated. Local multi-context capability is broader than native export. Physical firmware/PLC remains unknown.
subroutine.next_test: Add one named wider native profile at a time: multiple leaf sections, then a stateful/control-flow leaf; test independent metadata, shared images/clock, local returns, unreachable invalid bodies and atomic export refusal.

timer.scope: TON/TOF/TP IDs0..254, bases1/10/100/1000ms plus native omitted-minute default; 1ms restricted TM0..5. TenMilliSeconds is admitted and backed by exact Man21 TON/TOF/TP false-option fixture save/fresh reopen. True options use separate narrow profiles.
timer.remaining: Complete remaining graph/operand/timer lifecycle/phase/START/STOP/skipped-repeat boundaries and native physical timing. A 10ms serialization proof is not a 10ms physical accuracy measurement.
timer.next_test: For each remaining timer base/mode/property/lifecycle case, compare independent boundary/held/reset/skipped-call traces and exact native words/Q; retain the separately proven 10ms serialization case.

base10ms.scope: TON/TOF/TP, preset5, false option flags, actualMan21

other_bases.scope: 100ms/1000ms and native omitted-minute default; mode/property contexts remain separately bounded

timer_retention.scope: Local TON/TOF retention. Product XML only (TON,true,false,1000ms,Man21) and (TOF,true,false,1000ms,Man21), validated from actual template token; separate generated watch product native runtime observations and false-flag controls.
timer_retention.remaining: Other bases/levels/combined flags and lifecycle cases are unqualified tool gaps; TP retention is not established. Do not lift all timer-option gates from one context.
timer_retention.next_test: Qualify one currently refused base/level/flag combination with a flags-off control and paused/resumed/completed/reset trace before widening the exact context allowlist.

timer_dynamic.scope: Local dynamic TON/TOF/TP model. Product XML only (TON,false,true,1000ms,Man21), actual token authority; generated watch product separately observed completing after preset reduction.
timer_dynamic.remaining: TOF/TP product XML, other bases/levels/combined flags, active-tick/clamp semantics and lifecycle require explicit proof. Separate GUI samples are not exact same-scan/tick measurements.
timer_dynamic.next_test: Qualify dynamic TOF or TP with a flags-off control and active preset increase/decrease/disable/rearm trace; do not combine retention without its own collision oracle.

counter.scope: Native C IDs0..254, P/V/E/D/F and R/S/CU/CD local state model/API/config/reverse; strict observed raw Counter Boolean-port graph subset and serial export.
counter.remaining: Resolve documented E/reset/input-collision/lifecycle questions against exact native observations, extend remaining graph/numeric-effect variants, validate physical behavior. One combined counter diagnostic does not close every counter mode.
counter.next_test: Resolve E/reset/load/CU/CD collision and first-RUN behavior with exact native status/word latches, then match independent VM/SDK traces and graph port order.

register_foundation.scope: Standalone strict Register config/graph codecs only: four IDs, explicit Lifo/Fifo/default Fifo; canonical three plain-LD input graph. Actual FIFO/LIFO projects have separate handbuilt editor/simulator research evidence; no C++/Program/VM/reverse whole-project integration.
register_foundation.remaining: Integrate typed state/IR/SDK/VM/reverse and exact graphs; resolve evaluation/reset/edge/call-history/lifecycle scope with bounded native evidence. Preserve whole-project active-R refusal until coherent support exists.
register_foundation.next_test: Integrate the canonical FIFO/LIFO profile through API/IR/VM/reverse/project first; test capacity16, empty/full, simultaneous requests, reset/consumed edges, self-status and skipped/repeated calls using the existing bounded native observations.

generic_block.scope: BLK/OUT_BLK/END_BLK are implemented only through admitted Timer/Counter/communication schemas, not arbitrary resource classes.
generic_block.remaining: Add each missing owned block family with typed ports/config/state, strict closed graph grammar and complete reverse/runtime path.
generic_block.next_test: For the exact new block kind, test owned port order/config/state and raw graph closure; reject unknown block classes and partial or mismatched IL/graph without changing the destination.

native_block_missing.scope: Documented target native resource has no integrated typed compiler path. Existing configuration parser refuses active unsupported collections rather than erasing them.
native_block_missing.remaining: Implement bounded config/state/ports/API/IL/VM/reverse/graphs, independent collision/error oracle and exact editor candidate. Preserve object budget and actual mode restrictions.
native_block_missing.next_test: Use this row source operands/config to define one closed typed block/opcode; add valid boundary and invalid-state/operand controls, complete reverse and exact native graph admission before enabling it.

clock_calendar.scope: RTC/calendar/schedule/system-word services are documentary only. plc::Clock and periodic S4/S5/S6 Boolean bits are not these calendar services.
clock_calendar.remaining: Implement coherent RTC image/set/adjust/schedule/absolute-counter semantics and writable permissions; rollover/calendar/invalid/battery/lifecycle/physical proof required.
clock_calendar.next_test: Add literal valid/invalid calendar, rollover, atomic snapshot and lifecycle cases for the exact RTC/schedule/system-word service; bind writable permissions and actual native configuration.

immediate.scope: Native immediate embedded/HSC I/O services are not implemented. Ordinary native process-image direct I/Q optimization does not satisfy READ_IMM/WRITE_IMM semantics.
immediate.remaining: Define typed return/error codes, actual ownership/forcing and image-update rules, HSC mode eligibility and graph binding, then test physical timing separately.
immediate.next_test: Add index/forcing/dedicated-output error-code controls and before/after image synchronization traces; verify target HSC-mode eligibility before native admission.

communication.scope: READ_VAR/WRITE_VAR/WRITE_READ_VAR typed static config, asynchronous local state, reverse and literal protocol FC1/2/3/4/5/6/15/16/23. Native XML at observed actual Man21/SL1 master static profiles; bare normal-M Execute/Abort and complete ordered M full-pin status graphs. Per-ID object variants remain bounded below.
communication.remaining: Dynamic properties/native port/profile variants, IOScanner/message/ETH ownership/serial electrical behavior, native transaction scheduling/errors/abort recovery and physical interoperability remain open. Editor save/reopen is not successful Modbus communication.
communication.next_test: Add one missing native parameter/link/pin profile with local literal PDU and timeout/abort/status/alias controls; execute a known native transaction separately from already-passed editor save/reopen.

native_profiles.READ_VAR: static MW/IW/I/Q, actualMan21/SL1 master; bare normal-M Execute/Abort and bounded full-pin status forms
native_profiles.WRITE_VAR: static MW/Q plus single coil/register, actualMan21/SL1 master; bounded bare/full-pin forms
native_profiles.WRITE_READ_VAR: static asymmetric MW buffers, actualMan21/SL1 master; bounded bare/full-pin forms
native_profiles.local_protocol: FC1/2/3/4/5/6/15/16/23; not a statement of every native server/client role

digital_config.scope: Default embedded 24 inputs/16 transistor outputs and ordinary process-image access supported; unsupported active filter/latch/run-stop/alarm/fallback configuration is not inferred from pin existence.
digital_config.remaining: Implement the specific active configuration and resource conflicts for this row, native reload/reverse/config ownership, then exact editor and physical behavior checks.
digital_config.next_test: For this exact filter/latch/run-stop/alarm/fallback setting, test ownership conflicts and boundary values, preserve all other hardware, and qualify the native configured candidate.

hardware_inactive.scope: Documented hardware family currently has only inactive/default template preservation and explicit active configuration refusal, if present in config.py; this is not executable feature support.
hardware_inactive.remaining: Implement owned active typed configuration, mode/operand/state/graph/port conflicts and native reverse; resolve catalogue primary conflicts, then exact editor and physical validation.
hardware_inactive.next_test: Define active typed settings for this row, including its model-specific limits and shared pin/resource conflicts; test valid endpoints, conflict rejection and lossless native reverse before enabling active configuration.

network_config.scope: Supported ordinary template communication settings and local Modbus protocol are narrower than the complete embedded networking/configuration service in this row.
network_config.remaining: Audit each row actual config admission and add exact native typed settings/roles/remote mapping and resource conflicts. Host loopback sockets do not prove PLC protocol/server/physical capability.
network_config.next_test: Audit this exact service against admitted template settings; add typed active configuration, valid/invalid role/address/remote-map controls and exact native readback. Keep host transport and native endpoint tests separate.

tasks.scope: Strict normal/freewheeling isolated MAST profile; active periodic/fast/event tasks remain refused. Shared I/O image optimization relies on this admitted scheduling boundary.
tasks.remaining: Add periodic/event contexts, priorities, triggering, update/interrupt image semantics and watchdog configuration. Tool instruction budget is not the physical controller watchdog.
tasks.next_test: Add the next native periodic/event scheduling profile with priority, image-update, interrupted-context and watchdog controls; verify ordinary isolated-MAST behavior remains identical.

retention_storage.scope: Cold initialization/persistent source globals in the local scan model do not implement PLC power-loss retention, explicit flash request, SD clone or post-configuration services.
retention_storage.remaining: Model distinct power-up/download/INIT/STOP/RUN and retention regions; implement native controls/config and storage semantics. Physical persistence/storage checks are mandatory and unavailable now.
retention_storage.next_test: Specify exact power-up/download/INIT/STOP/RUN or SD/post-configuration transitions for this row; add independent region/boundary traces and future physical persistence/readback cases.

absence.scope: TM200CE40T has no embedded analog inputs or outputs according to the model-specific audited source. Optional cartridge/expansion analog resources remain separate inventory rows.
absence.remaining: No embedded analog feature to implement. Keep explicit refusal; do not remove expansion/cartridge work or label the entire analog family inapplicable.
absence.next_test: Retain model-specific embedded-analog absence and reject an attempted embedded channel; optional analog cartridges/expansion remain separately assigned.

unknown_model_eligibility.scope: Catalogue explicitly says not established by reviewed target documents; absence of documentation is not proof the PLC cannot implement it.
unknown_model_eligibility.remaining: Obtain model-specific primary eligibility proof before creating an implementation task or asserting model impossibility. Do not promote generic/future firmware or external gateway services.
unknown_model_eligibility.next_test: Resolve one named protocol eligibility from a model-specific primary source or actual target capability; until then retain the unresolved row without claiming support or impossibility.
